data.one_liner: Manage overlays like dialogs, panels, notifications, windows, and dropdowns easily.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified system for showing and managing various overlay types on screen such as dialogs, panels, notifications, floating windows, autocomplete suggestions, and expandable dropdowns. Overlays can be triggered imperatively using static methods or declaratively via helper widgets.
use_when: You need a simple way to display custom dialogs, notifications, or panels from anywhere in your code.
You want built-in support for auto-complete boxes and expandable dropdown widgets.
avoid_when: You are using complex routing setups that do not support providing a global NavigatorState or custom router key.
strengths: Supports multiple overlay formats out of the box (dialogs, panels, windows, notifications).
Provides helper widgets like OverAutoComplete and OverExpander.
Allows background customization, animations, and automatic dismissal timers.
weaknesses: Requires setting a global NavigationKey or passing context every time.
Animation documentation in the README is marked as TODO.
data.setup_notes: Requires assigning the NavigatorState key to Overlayment.navigationKey at app startup.
